# sp_ModifyGroupProperty on a dictionary connection in an empty folder (the
# dictionary, de/de.add, is kept in fixtures/sql/spddgprops/): the properties
# a group has, by name and by number, the values they take, what is refused,
# a user who is not the administrator, and a free connection.
#
#     run.sh <work> <ace32.dll> spddgprops.txt > ../../../fixtures/sql/spddgprops.json
#     cp <work>/data/de/* ../../../fixtures/sql/spddgprops/
ddcreate de\de.add
stmt
direct CREATE TABLE t1 (id INTEGER, name CHAR(10), PRIMARY KEY (id))
direct CREATE INDEX nm ON t1 (name)
direct CREATE VIEW v1 AS SELECT id FROM t1
direct CREATE PROCEDURE p1(a INTEGER) BEGIN INSERT INTO t1 VALUES (3, 'three'); END
direct CREATE TRIGGER tr1 ON t1 AFTER INSERT BEGIN INSERT INTO t1 VALUES (3, 'three'); END
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_CreateGroup('g1', 'a group')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_CreateUser('u1', 'pw1', 'a user')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', 'COMMENT', 'new comment')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', 'comment', 'lower')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', '1', 'by number')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', ' 1', 'by number with a blank')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', 'USER_DEFINED_PROP', 'user defined')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', '3', 'defined by number')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', 'COMMENT', '')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', 'COMMENT', NULL)
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', 'USER_DEFINED_PROP', '')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', 'USER_DEFINED_PROP', NULL)
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', 'COMMENT', 'a comment that is rather longer than the others, to take more than one line of the memo file it is kept in, which is why this sentence goes on for a while')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', 'COMMENT', 'short again')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', 'COMMENT', '')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', 'COMMENT', '')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', 'USER_DEFINED_PROP', '')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', 'USER_DEFINED_PROP', '')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', 'COMMENT', '')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', 'COMMENT', 'x')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', 'USER_DEFINED_PROP', 'x')
query SELECT * FROM system.usergroups
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('nogroup', 'COMMENT', 'x')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('', 'COMMENT', 'x')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty(NULL, 'COMMENT', 'x')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('u1', 'COMMENT', 'x')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('DB:Public', 'COMMENT', 'x')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('DB:Admin', 'USER_DEFINED_PROP', 'x')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('G1', 'COMMENT', 'case')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', 'NOPE', 'x')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', '', 'x')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', NULL, 'x')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', '2', 'x')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', '999', 'x')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', '65535', 'x')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', '65536', 'x')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', '-1', 'x')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', '1.5', 'x')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', '1x', 'x')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', 'ADS_DD_COMMENT', 'x')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', 'USER_GROUP_NAME', 'x')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', 'OBJECT_NAME', 'x')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', 'TRIGGERS_DISABLED', 'x')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', 'COMMENT')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', 'COMMENT', 'x', 'y')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', 'COMMENT', 1)
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', 1, 'x')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty(1, 'COMMENT', 'x')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty()
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('ccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc', 'COMMENT', 'x')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', 'ccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc', 'x')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('nogroup', 'NOPE', 'x')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', 'NOPE', 5)
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('nogroup', 'COMMENT', 5)
#
# A user who is not the administrator.
disconnect
connect de\de.add u1 pw1
stmt
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', 'COMMENT', 'by a user')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('nogroup', 'COMMENT', 'by a user')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', 'NOPE', 'by a user')
#
# A free connection to the folder: no dictionary.
disconnect
connect de
stmt
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyGroupProperty('g1', 'COMMENT', 'free')
